subject.title: [Bug]: Session label is lost when dashboard session metadata is rewritten / sessionId rotates

question: Should maintainers require a focused live/store-level reproduction before promoting this same-key dashboard label-loss report to an automated fix PR?
rationale: Current source preserves labels in the main writers, while the issue reports a concrete store-level symptom without logs or a narrowed writer, so automation cannot safely pick the fix boundary yet.

options.title: Run focused repro first
options.body: Exercise Control UI label edit plus reset, compaction, new run, metadata refresh, and sessionId rotation while diffing the same store key before choosing a code change.

options.title: Ask reporter for store snapshots
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for before/after redacted `sessions.json` entries and the exact lifecycle action that drops `label`.

options.title: Fold into display-title work
options.body: Only choose this if maintainers confirm the reporter's store-level label loss is actually a display/event reconciliation symptom rather than persisted metadata deletion.

recommendation.title: Run focused repro first
recommendation.body: Exercise Control UI label edit plus reset, compaction, new run, metadata refresh, and sessionId rotation while diffing the same store key before choosing a code change.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal is on the gateway session-store and reset paths that must be inspected or instrumented for the reproduction.
